evidence.definition: Age dependency ratio, old, is the ratio of older dependents--people older than 64--to the working-age population--those ages 15-64. Data are shown as the proportion of dependents per 100 working-age population.
evidence.source_organization:
World Population Prospects, United Nations (UN), publisher: UN Population Division;
Staff estimates, World Bank (WB)
evidence.universe: mapped countries and territories with data
